simple.meaning: יָשַׂם (yâsam) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to place ; intransitively, to be placed.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Genesis, beginning at Genesis 24:33. The surrounding contexts include death, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָשַׂם (H3455) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: יָשַׂם (yâsam) / H3455 is traced through Genesis 24:33, Genesis 50:26 with source-language evidence and verse context.
